title: packpass — EU packaging-EPR plan for small non-EU Etsy and Shopify sellers
oneLiner: For small non-EU Etsy/Shopify sellers who just got asked for EU packaging EPR numbers, it turns a short questionnaire into a country-by-country registration plan with costs, labels and deadlines, plus a ledger of their IDs, for $29 instead of paying a representative 190 EUR per country to find out.
overlaps: none (nearest in portfolio: tripsplit/Open-Travel are unrelated; outside the portfolio, Listadum's free guide and EPR Representative's paid service)
